messages.subject: make.capthist problem
parts:
Hello everyone!

My master thesis is about estimation of roe deer density through camera trapping and SECR. I have a problem when I try to create the capthist object: make.capthist(captures_prox, traps_analysis, fmt="trapID", noccasions = max_occasions). The message of error is: Error in make.capthist(captures_prox, traps_analysis, fmt = "trapID", : fewer usage fields than max(occasion).
